protocol: v6 subject expansion, frozen before download and training
split_rule: Among S1..S70 excluding all 24 historical v2 BETA subjects and all five v5 confirmation subjects, sort remaining filenames by SHA256(expanded-v6:filename); first 12 train, next 5 new test. Frozen before signal read.
fit: new EEGNetStudent initialization, window-local preprocessing, no D1/D2 input or labels in training
confirm: After all 3 checkpoints frozen, score v5 fourteen models, v6 models, and fixed FBCCA on five new BETA subjects. Then D1/D2 historical verification with unchanged weights. No selection on confirmation.
scope: 6 channels CP3 CPZ CP4 PO3 POZ PO4, 250 Hz, eight 8-15 Hz classes, 1.5 s onset window
